responsibility: Provides the autogenerated documentation cross-reference table for IA-64 target options defined in ia64.opt. It maps each backend switch name—covering endianness, GNU tool selection, PIC/GP handling, inline divide and sqrt strategies, TLS sizing, tuning, and IA-64 scheduling/speculation controls—to the corresponding anchor in the generated GCC manual, so option-processing metadata can be connected to user-facing help and diagnostics without changing the option definitions themselves.
